desc:
♻️ Welcome to Junkyard Simulator!

A player's trash is another player's treasure!💰

Explore the junkyard, collect valuable junk, and bring your best finds back to your plot and turn piles of scrap into a money-making empire!

🔓 EARLY ACCESS: Expect bugs, updates, and changes along the way!
🗑️ COLLECT and discover rare junk!
🏗️ BUILD your junkyard on your own plot!
💵 EARN CASH from the junk placed on your plot!
🎒 UPGRADE your backpack to carry more and heavier junk!
👟 EQUIP BOOSTERS to move faster around the junkyard!
⚙️ COMPRESS unwanted junk into valuable blocks!
📖 COMPLETE INDEX by discovering different junk!

✨ Keep an eye out for Legendary, Mythic & Secret Junk!

CODE: EARLY ACCESS
